name: travel-plan-saved-phone

init: document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.dataset.compare = 'static'; s.textContent = '#journey-view { max-height: none !important; overflow: visible !important; } .plan-back-row, .plan-actions { position: static !important; }'; document.head.append(s); })

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.dataset.compare = 'static'; s.textContent = '#journey-view { max-height: none !important; overflow: visible !important; } .plan-back-row, .plan-actions { position: static !important; }'; document.head.append(s); })

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.textContent = '[title="Open the QA persona switcher"] { display: none !important; }'; document.head.append(s); })

note: Measuring aid, on both sides alike: the planner's own scrolling and its sticky bars (back row, Show the way / Add to plan) are made static, so an element scrolled into view for its screenshot isn't covered by a sticky bar or measured at a different scroll; layout and styles are otherwise untouched. The app's QA persona switcher (local only, not in the mock) is hidden: it floats over Add to plan on phones.

pairs.name: saved view
pairs.reason: The reminder starts on only where notifications are already allowed (the mock starts it on), and "We keep watching it" says what is watched (see that row): both rows are shorter here.

pairs.name: Remind me
pairs.reason: The reminder starts off without notifications allowed (the mock starts it on).

pairs.name: switch
pairs.reason: Off here, on in the mock (see Remind me): its colour, and it sits mid-row in a row of another height.

pairs.name: We keep watching it
pairs.reason: What is watched, as built: live delays and KVB notices (travel:watch-planned-trips). The mock adds "the weather", which the watcher doesn't check, and its own "This preview doesn't watch". It follows the reminder row (see Remind me).

pairs.name: watching icon
pairs.reason: After the reminder row, which is taller in the mock (its reminder is on), it lands on a different sub-pixel y, so its edges and glyphs rasterise differently. Box and styles match.
